title: Google launches Lyria 3.5 AI for full songs with vocals #lyria3 #aimusic #googledeepmind
description: Google released Lyria 3.5, an AI music model that creates full songs with vocals, lyrics, and stems in under a minute. Integrated into Google Flow Music, Lyria 3.5 generates up to 3-minute tracks based on user prompts, featuring natural-sounding vocals that handle emotion, pronunciation, and multiple languages. Unlike earlier AI music tools, Lyria 3.5 offers stem exports for drums, bass, and vocals, allowing producers to work with individual track elements. Trained exclusively on licensed data, it avoids the copyright issues faced by competitors like Suno and Udio. This innovation significantly reduces the time from song idea to finished demo, advancing AI’s role in music production. #GoogleDeepMind #Lyria3_5 #GoogleFlowMusic #AIMusic #MusicProduction #AIInnovation #MusicTech #MusicAI #AIVocals #StemExport #CopyrightSafeAI #MusicCreation #AIProducer #GoogleAI #MusicIndustry
